heading: •BoShek’s Modified Light Freighter (V)
game_text: May add 2 pilots. While BoShek piloting: maneuver and hyperspeed +2; immune to attrition < 4; and if at a battleground system, may add 1 to Force drains here.

notes: Group: Everything Else. COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (756×1099): renamed card printed over Medium Bulk Freighter. Title bar: starship disc (dark disc, blue/white streaked starfighter, as printed), '•BoShek’s Modified Light Freighter' (curly ’), destiny 3. LORE printed on the slip, identical to the printed card (3 lines, first indented; 'engine system similar' with a space). Ring right of lore box: Special Edition sphere (as printed); no Episode I icon. Art window blank. Banner 'STARFIGHTER – MODIFIED LIGHT FREIGHTER' (spaced en-dash, as the sheet's text layer has it); POWER 3 / MANEUVER 3 / HYPERSPEED 4; scomp ring; deploy 3 / forfeit 4. Icon column: Independent (blue wheel), Nav Computer; then VS16 sphere. Credits under the text box: 'Original concept by JW Millet' (left) / 'PC Volunteer Award 2007' (right). Caption 'Medium Bulk Freighter (V)' (no dot — the base card is unrestricted), number 25. Layout matches the printed card's proportions (banner/text box not raised). CHANGES vs printed Medium Bulk Freighter (SE, CAPITAL: YV-CLASS FREIGHTER, unrestricted): title → •BoShek’s Modified Light Freighter (unique); banner CAPITAL → STARFIGHTER – MODIFIED LIGHT FREIGHTER; ARMOR 4 → MANEUVER 3 (POWER 3, HYPERSPEED 4, destiny 3, deploy 3 / forfeit 4 unchanged); icons Independent + Pilot + Nav → Independent + Nav; text replaced (printed: 'Deploys and moves like a starfighter. May add 2 pilots, 6 passengers and 1 vehicle. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Has ship-docking capability. Quad Laser Cannon may deploy aboard.'). Slip text matches the stub. Base scan only 350 px; SE copyright line read off the scan (1998). No modern remake of this slip found (the wiki has no 'BoShek's Modified Light Freighter' page/image despite the stub's link).
